read_first: House owner before House operational, permanent-unit, readiness or membership-assignment mutation
write_order: update the canonical aggregate owner for organization, membership classification, permanent units and operating state
update genuinely separate authorities such as inventory stock only when causally changed
rebuild owner/unit indexes and derived caches
invariants: Player personal organization is not invented.
Returning units restore home chain without resetting losses.
One semantic mutable fact has one writable owner; a sidecar may exist only for a genuinely separate authority or rebuildable derived data.
When a House owner embeds permanent units, member assignment classification, standing readiness and its operating process, those facts are not mirrored in mutable House sidecars.
House member_ids contains persistent identity-bearing members only; ordinary Sword Manor personnel are conserved in aggregate cohort counts under the House owner.
Routine House cohort development is one aggregate write; do not create or update one person owner per ordinary member.
